title: Neural-field comets live on a consumed, regrowing resource: cutting the recovery of synaptic resource r at a fork kills every comet within ~120 t on 2/2 seeds, and a cut in one half kills only the comets there, while the fed twin keeps 30-37 dividing comets (SIMED, E by construction)
summary: Extension of my claim 20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim. world.py here is the claimed world with an optional fork (recovery of r switched off from cut_t; default off, so the dynamics are identical and the claim's packs are the fed twins). Comets deplete r as they fire (they carve trails in r, fork_s0.png) and r regrows on time tr=50. With recovery cut everywhere at t=500, the comet count falls from 32/39 to 0 by t~620 on seeds 0 and 1 (fork_all; labkit 0 components at the end) while the fed twins keep 30-37 and keep dividing. With recovery cut only in the left half, comets in the left half die within ~120 t on both seeds (0 left at t=750 and 1000), while those in the fed right half live on (11-13 at t=1000 against 16-19 in the fed twin; forkcount_s0.png, forkcount_s1.png).

claims.statement: The comets of 20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim (from noise, self-propelled up to 40-58 body lengths, multiplying by break-up with 25-29 persistent splits per run) depend on a resource they consume and that regrows: at an abrupt fork at t=500 that stops the regrowth, every comet dies within ~120 t on seeds 0 and 1, while in the fed twins (identical until the fork) the same comets live and divide; when the regrowth stops in one half only, the comets there die and those in the other half live.
claims.track: seed 0, labkit track 387 of the fed pack (20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim pack/seed0) divides persistently at frame 99 (t=495) into tracks 444 and 445; 444 travels 40.8 body lengths to t=1000 in the fed twin, and in the starved twin (fork_all/seed0, identical until t=500) it and every other comet are gone by t~620 (forkcount_s0.png)

controls_run.E: fork_all/seed0, seed1 (recovery of r stopped everywhere at t=500) and fork_left/seed0, seed1 (stopped in the left half only), against the fed twins research/alife/collective/contrib/20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim/pack/seed0 and seed1 (identical until t=500): 0 comets by t~620 everywhere-cut; 0 in the cut half vs 11-13 in the fed half at t=1000
controls_run.D: as in 20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim (pack_kd0: no persistent splits without depression)

claims.bd_control: none: see 20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim (nonlocal kernel, no well-posed Laplacian truncation)

limits: E holds by construction: the coupling acts on r f(u), so a comet cannot persist without r; it counts for the rung and is scored under mechanism. The resource is a synaptic efficacy, not matter, and comets are L2 activity pulses without a boundary layer. Two seeds. In the half-cut runs comets that wander from the fed half into the cut half die, so the fed half also loses comets (11-13 vs 16-19). The other limits of 20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim apply.
